headline_pain: What Happens When Your Lease Ends?
primary_text: "Our lease is up in 12 months and the landlord wants a 30% increase or we're out." What's your plan B? Pay the increase and eat the cost? Move everything to a new premises and lose weeks of productivity? There's a third option. Buy your own warehouse off the plan in Truganina and never be at a landlord's mercy again. Lock in a fixed price today and settle when construction completes. 20km from Melbourne CBD. Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel access. What would your business look like with real certainty?
description: A third option beyond paying more or moving — own your own warehouse
